annotations.title: Add or remove people on a Pinterest customer list

description: ADD people to (or REMOVE people from) an existing Pinterest customer list by email or mobile ad id — hashed on our server before they leave it. The list’s counts are read back before and after. Pinterest matches in the background, so the audience size can take hours to move. 0 credits.

adAccountId.description: Pinterest ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

customerListId.description: id of the customer list to change

emails.description: email addresses to add or remove (see operation); hashed on our server

maids.description: mobile ad ids to add or remove (see operation); hashed on our server

name: update_pinterest_ads_customer_list
title: Add or remove people on a Pinterest customer list
